lessons.title: The Flexbox Mindset 🧠
lessons.description: Understand the container‑item relationship and the two axes that control flex layout.

lessons.title: Direction & Wrapping 🔀
lessons.description: Control the flow with `flex-direction`, `flex-wrap`, and the `flex-flow` shorthand.

lessons.title: Main Axis Alignment 📏
lessons.description: Distribute items along the main axis using `justify-content`.

lessons.title: Cross Axis Alignment 📐
lessons.description: Align items vertically (or horizontally) with `align-items` and `align-content`.

lessons.title: The `flex` Shorthand & Sizing Secrets 🎛️
lessons.description: Master `flex: 1`, `flex: auto`, `flex: none`, and how they compute actual sizes.

lessons.title: Flexbox Layout Patterns 🏗️
lessons.description: Build common UI patterns: centring, equal‑height columns, navigation, and sticky footer.
